America's military is the strongest, most lethal fighting force in the world. DEI policies threaten exactly this. 

Every dollar spent on these initiatives is a dollar taken away from readiness, lethality, and the warfighters who earn it. 

We thank Secretary Hegseth for restoring merit and standards back to our military where they belong.

We want the Death Penalty for anyone who rapes a child.

INTRODUCING: The Hire American Act.

This bill does exactly what its title says: hire American workers only. The legislation amends title 5 of the United States Code to restrict federal government employment to U.S. citizens and nationals ONLY.

American taxpayers foot the bill for every single federal job in this country. Every salary. Every benefit. Every pension. Those jobs belong to American workers, not non-citizens. Right now, there is no permanent law stopping a non-citizen from being hir

The American people deserve to know exactly who is representing them and where their tax dollars are going. 

We made it our mission to deliver both.

READ HERE: nytimes.com/2026/05/02/us/po…

The House passed the SAVE America Act back in February. We've been waiting on the Senate to do the same ever since.

This bill is crucial to the integrity of our elections, especially with the midterms coming. Proof of citizenship to register and photo ID to vote. This should be common sense.

PASS THE SAVE AMERICA ACT.

Waffle House is where I got my start at 17 years old.

I have never forgotten where I came from or what a hard day’s work feels like. I have never forgotten what it means to stretch a dollar as far as it can possibly go. 

Every decision I make is made with this in mind. The ones pulling double shifts. The ones building something from nothing because no one handed them anything. The hardworking people of South Carolina.

South Carolina raised me right. And I am going to keep working like it.

It has been almost two years now since the "No Kings" crowd tried to appoint a queen. After receiving no votes in the Presidential Primary, Kamala Harris SOMEHOW became the Democrat nominee. 

And no one questioned it.

We are working full-force to advance President Trump's Make America Great Again agenda. 

MAGA is not just a slogan. It is a mandate to put America First and deliver on the promises made to the American people. 

Secure the border. Cut wasteful spending. Rebuild our military. Restore America's strength on the world stage. 

South Carolina sent us to Washington to get it done. We are delivering every single day.

Making America Safe Again has been a top priority from day one, and we are working alongside President Trump to deliver. 

For years, the radical left demonized police officers, defunded departments, installed soft-on-crime prosecutors, and opened our borders to violent criminals who flooded into American communities. 

Law-abiding citizens were left to pay the price. Those days are over. 

President Trump made it clear from the very beginning: America will stand with law enforcement. Under his

We've solved 214 constituent cases with the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services, helping return $323,000 back to the people of South Carolina.

When seniors and families are buried in red tape, delayed payments, or denied answers, we step in and get results.

Helping South Carolinians navigate Washington and access the benefits they've earned will always be a top priority.

South Carolina STRONG.

Clean food. Clean water. Honest science. It’s time to put the health of the American people ahead of corporate profits and hold government agencies accountable to the people they serve.

We fully stand with President Trump and the MAHA initiative because South Carolina families deserve transparency, accountability, and real answers. Our children deserve a healthier future than what Washington has allowed for far too long.

Make America Healthy Again.

MACE WIN: We helped secure the largest infrastructure grant in South Carolina state history. $195 million to improve Long Point Road for the Port.

The Port of Charleston is one of the largest job creators in our state and generates a staggering $87 billion in annual statewide economic impact.

This critical investment will strengthen the port, reduce congestion, and keep freight and families moving while supporting jobs and economic growth across the Lowcountry.

South Carolina STRONG.

A lot of you know, when I dropped out of school at just 17 years old, I got my first job working at the Waffle House at College Park Road in Ladson. My parents told me if I wasn't going to go to school, I had to go to work.

From there I went on to become the first female to graduate from the Corps of Cadets at The Citadel, where I was taught discipline, accountability, leadership, and how to keep going even when things got tough.

From those experiences, I knew I wanted to make a difference. I

We’ve tried multiple times to remove Ilhan Omar from Congress, but have been consistently blocked from doing so.

Our Constitutional Amendment to ensure anyone serving in the federal government was born in America is something we need ahead of the midterms this year.

We work for America, and America ONLY.

Video

When the people of South Carolina sent us to Washington, we made a promise: to work for YOU.

We have NEVER voted to raise your taxes in Congress because when you work hard for your money, it should stay in your pockets.

South Carolina STRONG.

President Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill has been delivering for South Carolina and we backed it from the very first day.

It puts hardworking families first by prioritizing tax relief, cutting Washington waste, and making sure South Carolinians keep more of what they earn.

It restores law and order at the border by ending failed policies and giving law enforcement the tools they need to keep our communities safe.

It fully supports our military. Ensuring the men and women at Joint Base Charles

American taxpayers are being taken advantage of and most have no idea it is happening.

Sanctuary cities block ICE, refuse to share immigration information with federal authorities, and turn their cities into safe havens for criminal illegal immigrants. All while collecting tax-exempt financing through municipal bonds.

We introduced the No Tax Breaks for Sanctuary Cities Act to end it. Our bill strips sanctuary cities of tax-exempt municipal bonds, ensuring cities choosing to violate federal im

Military families sacrifice more than most Americans will ever understand.

Right now, pregnancy is not even considered a qualifying life event under TRICARE. This means expectant military moms and spouses cannot change their healthcare plan to meet their maternal care needs.

We introduced the Military Moms Act to change this. Our bill classifies pregnancy and pregnancy loss as qualifying life events under TRICARE, giving military moms and spouses the power to choose the healthcare plan best su

President Trump is the law and order president.
